content.text: The stats API caps a window at about 7 days, so I'll pull the last stretch separately and add it to the earlier totals.

The campaign ran from Jan 16 to Jan 27 (Dublin time) and has now expired. Total spend was $332.37 of the $350 budget. The recap is below. I can only send it here in chat, since I don't have an email or messaging tool.

**Wrenwell, Ireland and UK sole traders: campaign recap (16–27 Jan 2027)**

- **Spend:** $332.37 of $350.00 (USD, the account's billing currency)
- **Impressions:** 347,719
- **Link clicks:** 219 (about 0.06% CTR, about $1.52 per click)
- **Installs:** not measured. X can't see installs on this site, so the numbers above are clicks to wrenwell.ie/card only.

**By post**

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| "Be honest: how many of your invoices are still sitting in drafts?" (2142592356972799672) | $199.54 | 137,447 | 131 |
| "€0 for three months…" (2142773550907671340) | $75.48 | 114,009 | 50 |
| "Sole trader? Wrenwell is a business debit card…" (2142411163038965262) | $57.35 | 96,263 | 38 |

Cost per click was almost the same for all three (about $1.51–$1.52). The drafts post got most of the spend and most of the clicks because it was served the most.

**What I set up**

- One campaign, "Wrenwell - Sole traders IE/UK - 16-27 Jan 2027", on the account's existing card.
- One line item, objective website clicks with a link-click goal, targeting Ireland and the UK, all placements. It had a $29/day budget and a $350 lifetime cap.
- All three approved posts attached to that line item. All were accepted by X and none were changed or replaced.
- The first post was already live as an organic post, so I attached it as-is. I didn't write any new copy.

**Things to know**

- I didn't pause or change any post during the run. Costs stayed even across the three, so I didn't have a reason to. I also didn't add ad groups, because one was enough to spend the full budget.
- The run started and ended on your dates. The end time is midnight Dublin time on Jan 28, which is the same as midnight UTC in January.
- The campaign is now expired and nothing is still running, so there's no further spend.
- If you want installs counted next time, the landing page needs an X pixel or an app install tag. Clicks alone can't show installs.
